data.title: ROS News for the Week of July 20th, 2026
data.description: ROS News for the week of July 20th, 2026                      I’ve had quite the week! In the past seven days, I’ve been to Open Sauce, AMD’s developer conference, and now I’m at Teardown in Portland. It might have also been my birthday this week. 🎂  I’ve run into so many fantastic people building wonderful ROS robots, including a working Johnny 5 replica, a giant art robot with cast aluminum components, a hexapod with a 25 kg payload, a room full of SO-101s, a controllable robot t...
